## react-big-schedule 10.0.1

- **Much faster view switching with many events.** With 10,000 events over 1,000 resources, switching to Year went from about 4.5 s to about 30 ms of data work, and to the vertical resource view from about 1 s to under 30 ms plus a lean render (the DOM drops from about 66,000 to 3,400 nodes). Events are now placed with a binary search over the header cells instead of re-parsing dates for every cell, and the header cells are built once instead of once per row.
- **Virtual rendering now also windows columns**: the vertical view (one column per resource) and very wide timelines mount only the columns near the viewport.
